claim: Repeat purchasing rose after the loyalty launch
test: Two-proportion z-test, 90-day repeat rate of first-time buyers

claim: The loyalty effect holds with delivery held constant (on-time first orders only)
A late first delivery lowers the chance of a second order
test: Chi-square test of independence (2x2) and odds ratio
result: repeat 38.2% on time vs 25.9% late; on-time buyers have 1.77x the odds of returning

claim: The new courier delivers faster in Greece
test: Mann-Whitney U (one-sided; delivery days are skewed, so no t-test)

claim: Average order value fell in 2025 (bulk orders excluded)
Cash-on-delivery orders are cancelled more often
Discount codes do not make customers buy more units
result: 3.17 vs 3.18 units/order; within-month diff +0.008 (95% CI -0.017 to +0.034)

claim: Discount codes do not raise the basket value before discount
result: EUR 170.22 vs 170.95; within-month diff EUR +0.97 (95% CI -0.67 to +2.78)

claim: Discounted orders earn less gross profit
result: EUR 67.79 vs 44.56 per order; within-month diff EUR -23.27 (95% CI -24.09 to -22.48), lower in 24 of 24 months

claim: First orders with a discount do not create more loyal customers
test: Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test, stratified by first-order month
result: 90-day repeat 32.6% full price vs 31.0% discounted; common odds ratio 0.96 (95% CI 0.92 to 1.00)
